title: Rabbi Ilam

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eichah Rabbah 2:12, but Vayikra Rabbah 12:5 has the reading Rabbi Hillel bar Hilni.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Ilam and Hillel bar Hilni are the competing name forms attributed to the two Midrash sources.

The whole named Torat Emet Eikhah Rabbah 2:12 explicitly names Rabbi Ilam, while Vayikra Rabbah 12:5 explicitly names Rabbi Hillel bar Hilni. The corresponding local full titles are supported; Hyman’s comparison and the current note remain, without treating these forms as one canonical identity or importing their teachings.
